title: Cups to Grams Converter: Flour, Sugar, Butter and More
excerpt: Convert cups to grams for flour, sugar, butter, milk, oats and more: 1 cup of all-purpose flour is 120 g, 1 cup of sugar 200 g. Free converter and chart.
html:
American recipes measure by the cup; most of the world weighs in grams. A cup measures volume, so a cup of flour and a cup of sugar weigh quite different amounts. Pick the ingredient below and the converter does the arithmetic.

Quick answer: 1 cup of all-purpose flour = 120 g. 1 cup of granulated sugar = 200 g. 1 cup of butter = 227 g. 1 cup of water = 237 g.

Cups to grams converter

Choose an ingredient, type an amount in cups, tablespoons, teaspoons, grams or ounces, and read the rest.

Why a cup of flour and a cup of sugar weigh different amounts

A cup holds the same volume of anything, 236.6 ml, but ingredients pack differently. Flour is light and full of air, so a cup weighs about 120 g; sugar crystals sit closer together, so a cup weighs about 200 g; honey is dense and weighs 340 g a cup. That is why a single "cups to grams" number doesn't exist: it always depends on the ingredient.

How to measure flour by the cup

How you fill the cup changes the weight more than anything else. Scooping the cup straight into the bag packs the flour down and can give you noticeably more than 120 g, enough to make cakes dry and cookies tough. For the weights in this chart:

  • Stir the flour to loosen it.
  • Spoon it into a dry measuring cup until it mounds over the top.
  • Level it with the back of a knife, without pressing.

Better still, use a kitchen scale: it is faster and gives the same result every time.

Tablespoons and teaspoons to grams

A tablespoon is 1/16 cup and a teaspoon 1/48 cup, so: a tablespoon of flour weighs about 7.5 g, sugar 12.5 g, butter 14 g and honey 21 g. A teaspoon of sugar is about 4 g. For leaveners and salt, which recipes use in small amounts, measure with spoons rather than converting.

Cups to grams FAQ

How many grams are in a cup of flour?

About 120 grams of all-purpose or bread flour, spooned and levelled. Whole wheat flour is a little lighter, about 113 grams.

How many grams are in a cup of sugar?

Granulated sugar is about 200 grams a cup, packed brown sugar about 213 grams, and powdered sugar about 120 grams.

How many grams is 1 cup of butter?

227 grams, which is two US sticks. The butter conversion calculator covers sticks, tablespoons and ounces too.

How many grams are in a cup of water?

About 237 grams, since a cup is 236.6 ml and a millilitre of water weighs a gram.

How many cups is 250 g of flour?

About 2 cups + 1⅓ tbsp of all-purpose flour.

How many cups is 100 g of sugar?

Half a cup of granulated sugar.
